title: Estaba durmiendo cuando llamaste
titleEn: I was asleep when you called
blurbEn: The same structure moved into the past — which is where it meets the imperfecto from Unit 7.
body:
Anoche me llamaste tres veces y no contesté.

Lo siento. Estaba durmiendo.

Últimamente estoy muy cansada. Esta semana estoy trabajando doce horas al día porque estamos preparando el informe anual.

Ayer, cuando me llamaste a las diez, estaba corrigiendo la última página. A las once ya estaba en la cama.

Necesito dormir ocho horas seguidas. Necesito recuperar el sueño perdido.

Mi jefe dice que la semana que viene todo va a ser más tranquilo. No le creo, pero es agradable oírlo.

Esta noche voy a apagar el teléfono. Si me llamas y no contesto, ya sabes por qué.
translationEn:
Last night you called me three times and I didn't answer.

I'm sorry. I was asleep.

Lately I have been very tired. This week I'm working twelve hours a day because we are preparing the annual report.

Yesterday, when you called me at ten, I was correcting the last page. By eleven I was already in bed.

I need to sleep eight hours in a row. I need to catch up on lost sleep.

My boss says that next week everything is going to be quieter. I don't believe him, but it is pleasant to hear.

Tonight I'm going to switch off the phone. If you call me and I don't answer, you already know why.

Estaba durmiendo.note: 'estar' in the imperfecto plus a gerund. It says what was going on when something else cut across it.

corrigiendo.note: The e becomes i, and the g becomes j to keep the sound.

phrases.note: You could also say 'dormía'. The gerund version stresses that it was in progress right then.
